title: Scenario candidate — a proposed dynamic (behavioral) view
description: One advisory scenario candidate (`generated/scenario-candidates/<source>/<slug>.json`, dynamic-view plan §2/§3.2). Four static sources (test / runtime / graph-walk / llm) each emit this SAME envelope: a `proposal` (the only promotable material — ordered steps over the container vocabulary, with STABLE container ids in from/to) plus the `validated_view` (the verbatim `build_dynamic_view` output, a `dynamic-view/2` artifact, what the GUI <SequenceStrip> renders). Nothing auto-promotes: a human promotes the good ones into the hand-owned rules/scenarios.yaml (plan §0.1#2). The validator's green check evidences edge EXISTENCE only, never call ORDER — `ordering_provenance` is the reader's trust signal (plan §1a#4).
$comment: ADVISORY schema (NOT the determinism-hashed fact-model core): no `arch validate` wiring and no schema/CHANGELOG core entry — validated INLINE by the producer (stages/scenario_candidates.py) and tests via validate_facts.find_schema('scenario-candidate.schema.json') + jsonschema.validate, exactly the enrich_llm.py pattern for llm-output / llm-narrative. `validated_view` is left as a permissive object here and validated separately against schema/dynamic-view.schema.json by scenarios.validate_dynamic_view (jsonschema has no cross-file $ref resolver wired in this codebase). derived_from_hash = content_hash(facts_emitted) (emission-normalized provenance, plan §0.4#4), NEVER the serve If-Hash freshness comparator. A/B/graph-walk candidates are byte-identical across runs; the llm source is excluded from the determinism gate (off by default, never in CI).

source.description: Which of the four static sources produced this candidate (plan §2). The candidate key is source-prefixed (test- / runtime- / walk- / llm-).

confidence.description: Source-level confidence in edge existence. Runtime (B) is high for edge existence (declared Aspire wiring); graph-walk (C) is low (synthesized ordering); test (A) is low; llm (F) is medium. NOTE the note field states any edge-vs-ordering confidence split (plan §5).

ordering_provenance.description: How the step ORDERING was arrived at (plan §1a#4 / §0.4#5). Survives promotion into scenarios.yaml. The validator never validates order, so this is the reader's trust signal.

salience.description: Deterministic, engine-computed ranking score (plan §1a#3): entry-point bonus + sum of per-step weight + distinct-container count. The inbox / picker sorts by (source, -salience, slug).

salience_reasons.description: Human-readable reasons that contributed to salience (e.g. 'entry-point (sdk-role:service-web)', 'crosses 3 containers').

derived_from_hash.description: content_hash(facts_emitted) — honest provenance of exactly the emission-normalized facts the candidate was validated against (plan §0.4#4). NOT the serve If-Hash freshness comparator.

proposal.description: The ONLY promotable material: ordered steps over the container vocabulary. Promotion lifts {key, name, scope, steps[from, to, order, description]} into rules/scenarios.yaml.

scope.description: The literal 'system' or a container name/id the view drills into.

steps.description: Ordered proposal steps. from/to are STABLE build-target ids / container_ids (display names live in from_name/to_name only, plan §0.4#6).

from_name.description: Source container display name (label only — never promoted as the endpoint).

order.description: Non-unique parallel-band index (plan §2/§3.1#5): concurrent / fan-out steps share an order.

description.description: The step message (label policy §1a#2 — never a bare 'Uses').

validated_view.description: The verbatim build_dynamic_view(proposal, facts_emitted) output — a dynamic-view/2 artifact. Validated separately against schema/dynamic-view.schema.json (this schema keeps it a permissive object; see $comment).

note.description: Source-level note (e.g. the runtime edge-vs-ordering confidence split, plan §5; the graph-walk 'synthesized, not observed' caveat, plan §6).

notes.description: Optional structured side-notes the GUI renders to explain boundaries.

out_of_model.description: Runtime container→infra hops that are NOT C4-container steps (plan §0.3): the chain 'appears to stop' at an infra resource — recorded, never silently dropped.
